characters.name: Gjertrud
characters.prompt: A Norwegian woman in the 1400s–1850s, wearing a simple dress and a distinctive red cap, kneading dough for lefse in a rustic wooden kitchen; she has a slightly stern expression.

characters.name: Our Lord (Jesus)
characters.prompt: A serene traveler dressed in simple robes, with gentle features, quietly requesting bread; he stands gracefully, gazing upon Gjertrud's baking.

characters.name: St. Peter
characters.prompt: A humble companion wearing a worn cloak and practical shoes, carrying a rustic walking staff; he stands by Our Lord with a patient, observant demeanor.

characters.name: Gjertrudsfuglen (bird form)
characters.prompt: A small black bird with a distinct red crest on its head, symbolizing Gjertrud’s transformation; it persistently pecks at tree bark under the cloudy Norwegian sky.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: A vivid scene set in rural Norway between 1400 and 1850. Inside a dimly lit wooden cottage, Gjertrud is near a stone hearth, wearing her red cap as she rolls dough for lefse. Our Lord and St. Peter, clad in simple traveling clothes, stand quietly requesting a taste. The tension is visible on Gjertrud’s face as she hesitates to share. Smoke drifts up through the chimney, and the rustic interior captures the modest life of the era.
modernMainImagePrompt: Depict a bright, contemporary Norwegian kitchen with modern appliances. Gjertrud wears a stylish red beanie while she bakes fresh flatbread. Two casual visitors—the modern counterparts of Our Lord and St. Peter—politely ask for a small sample. The contrast between Gjertrud’s reluctance and the welcoming, homey kitchen reflects a modern twist on the original tale.
childMainImagePrompt: Create a warm, storybook-style illustration in bright colors. Gjertrud, smiling yet hesitant, wears a fun red hat while rolling dough in a cozy Norwegian cottage. Two friendly travelers with gentle expressions stand nearby, asking if they can taste the flatbread. The atmosphere is playful, inviting, and clearly suited for a 5-year-old audience.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Tegn et koselig, gammeldags rom i Norge med enkle møbler. Gjertrud står ved et lite ildsted, iført en rød lue og en enkel kjole, mens hun lager lefser. To reisende spør pent om å få smake, men hun nøler. Rommet er lunt og opplyst bare av ildstedet, og det er en følelse av magi i luften.
englishMainImagePrompt: Create a detailed illustration of an old Norwegian home from the 1400s–1850s. Gjertrud, wearing a red hood, stands by a rustic fireplace, rolling out lefse. Nearby, two weary travelers (Our Lord and St. Peter) gently ask for a taste. Emphasize the dimly lit, wooden interior and the tense moment that foreshadows Gjertrud’s transformation into the bird.
